rejected_rule.statement: A plaintiff is not required to include two causes of action in the same suit when several causes of action arise from one transaction. The rule is directed against splitting claims and remedies in respect of one and the same cause of action.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: "Section 34 is directed to securing the exhaustion of the relief in respect of a cause of action and not to the inclusion in one and the same action of different causes of action, even though they arise from the same transaction" - per Lord Watson in Chand Kans vs. Partap Singh 15 I. A. 156 P.C.
rejected_rule.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 34 and 207 of the Civil Procedure Code
